outcome.Summary: Added `api/handler.go` implementing `NewHandler(s *Store) http.Handler` with the Go 1.24 ServeMux (standard library only). It serves GET /healthz (200 "ok" text/plain), POST /notes (validates non-empty trimmed title, else 400; returns 201 with the created note), GET /notes (JSON array ordered by id, `[]` when empty, with case-insensitive ?q= filter on title/body), GET/DELETE /notes/{id} (200/204, 404 if missing, 400 for non-integer id), and returns 405 JSON for disallowed methods. All JSON responses set Content-Type application/json and errors use {"error":"..."}. Added `api/handler_test.go` using net/http/httptest covering every endpoint and edge case (14 tests). Verified with `go vet ./... && go test ./...` — both exit 0; store.go was left untouched.
